notes.title: Current Electricity
notes.subject: Physics
points: I=neAvd in magnitude. Mobility μ=vd/E. Conductivity σ=neμ; resistivity ρ=1/σ and R=ρL/A.
Near a reference temperature, R=R₀[1+α(T−T₀)] when the linear approximation applies. Power P=VI=I²R=V²/R for a resistor.

notes.title: Solutions
notes.subject: Chemistry
points: Molarity: moles of solute/litres of solution. Molality: moles of solute/kg of solvent. Mole fraction: ni/Σnj. State which mass or volume is the denominator.
Henry: p=KH x at a given temperature. Raoult for an ideal volatile component: pi=xi pi°. For two volatile components, total pressure is the sum.
